name: NOCPERU DATA CENTER & NAP
notes: Corporate data center in Trujillo, La Libertad. NOCPERU identifies it as a corporate data center in Trujillo; DC Hub/Inflect list it as operational at Av. Larco with reported 3.0 MW capacity.

name: Equinix LM1 Lima IBX Data Center
notes: Equinix states it operates one Lima data center with 8,094 sq ft / 752 sq m of colocation space and 0.7 MW total capacity.

name: Cirion LIM1 Lima Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral data center at Av. Manuel Olguin 395, Santiago de Surco; operator describes it as the most connected data center in Peru.

name: Cirion LIM2 Lurin Data Center
notes: New carrier-neutral Lurin/Macropolis facility designed for hyperscale cloud providers, carriers and content providers; operator page lists 20 MW and 12,000 m2. 2025 press release reports Tier III Design certification.

name: GTD Peru Data Center Lurin
notes: DCD reported the Lurin site launched in 2024 as a 20 MW, $50m project with 960 cabinets planned; second phase investment of $13m planned for 2026.

name: GTD Peru Data Center Surco
notes: Aggregator listings identify GTD's Surco urban data center in Lima's business district; capacity not found in public sources reviewed.

name: Claro Data Center Villa El Salvador
notes: First phase inaugurated December 2023; DCD reports $50m investment, 250 sq m IT room, Uptime Tier III certification and 104 cabinets. Uptime listing confirms America Movil Peru project location in Lima.

name: WIN / ON Empresas La Molina Data Center
notes: DCD/BNamericas reported a sixth Peruvian data center planned just outside Lima in La Molina, with more than 600 cabinets total, 200 cabinets in phase one, $12m initial investment and $10m in later phases.

name: WIN / ON Empresas Data Center Santa Catalina
notes: Santa Catalina flagship facility in La Victoria/Lima. DCD reported it was already 80% occupied and planned expansion to maximum 2 MW; Datacenters.com lists 2 MW designed capacity and TIA-942 Rated 3 constructed certification.

name: NextStream Lince Data Center
notes: Former Nabiax Lince facility now associated with NextStream; DataCenterMap lists 1.2 MW IT power scalable to 2 MW and Tier III design/operation approach.

name: NextStream Monterrico Data Center
notes: Former Nabiax Monterrico facility now associated with NextStream; DataCenterMap reports 0.9 MW IT power and five IT rooms built/operated to Uptime Tier III standards.

name: ODATA Lurin Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists ODATA as building a data center in Lurin, Peru. Operator site confirms ODATA is an Americas data center provider, but project-specific public details were limited in reviewed sources.
